recent.text: Joe Milton is a fun player to watch. Patriots ended up trading him (he asked to be dealt) for a pick that turned out to be Andy Borregales, Julian Ashby and Kobee Minor. That was more than the Cowboys got, which was nothing, when the Eagles signed him off their practice squad.
recent.author: Mark Daniels

recent.text: They actually got a 5th rounder for him. Since the Cowboys literally cut him, and now they’re CRUSHING his team, I’d say it was a great trade
recent.author: Pat Lane
recent.quoted_text: Patriots gave this guy away for nothing
